skills.name: amplify-backend-standards
skills.description: Non-negotiable rules for all code under amplify/ in an Amplify Gen 2 project — folder-per-unit with interfaces and colocated tests, interface-typed DI, repository-owned data access, zod-validated input, registration, CloudFormation cycles, caller identity and secrets. Use when writing or reviewing any file under amplify/.

skills.name: amplify-data-model
skills.description: Changes the Amplify Gen 2 data schema in amplify/data/resource.ts — models, identifiers, relationships, secondary indexes, authorization rules, custom queries/mutations/subscriptions, and splitting a large schema into domain fragments. Use when asked to "add a model", "add a field", "add an index", "change auth rules" or "add a custom query/mutation" in an Amplify project.

skills.name: amplify-deploy
skills.description: Deploys, sandboxes and debugs an Amplify Gen 2 backend — ampx sandbox, function logs, secrets, reading failed CloudFormation deploys and circular-dependency errors. Use when asked to "deploy", "run the sandbox", "check the lambda logs" or "why did the deploy fail".

skills.name: amplify-lambda
skills.description: Adds or changes an Amplify Gen 2 Lambda function in amplify/functions — scaffolds resource.ts, a composition-root handler, service and repository with interfaces and tests, then registers it in backend.ts and the data schema. Use when asked to "add a lambda", "add a backend function", "add an API endpoint", "add an SQS/EventBridge consumer" or "add a scheduled job".

skills.name: appsync-js-resolver
skills.description: Writes or reviews AppSync JavaScript (APPSYNC_JS) resolvers in Amplify Gen 2 — runtime limits, cross-table names from awsAppsyncApiId and AMPLIFY_TABLE_ENV_NAME, caller identity from ctx.identity not arguments, pipelines via ctx.stash, util.error, a.handler.custom wiring. Use when touching a resolver .js file under amplify/data, adding a custom query/mutation without a Lambda, or when a resolver returns AccessDenied or null.
